# Traveltico

> Honest travel guides for Indian travellers — real budgets in rupees, real routes, the versions of places tourism brochures don't sell. Written by Swami Chavan, digital media professional with 12+ years of experience.

Every guide includes: full itinerary, real cost breakdowns in INR, visa rules for Indian passport holders, destination dossier (history, local myths, special points, highlights, connections), and FAQ.

## Guides

- [Bali for First-Timers: The Honest 7-Day Itinerary (Not the Instagram One)](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/bali-first-timers.html): The Bali plan that actually works — Canggu over Seminyak, sunrise at the rice terraces, Nusa Penida done right, and the real ₹65,000 budget with costs as observed in October 2026.
- [Dubai on a Budget from India: Real Costs, Visa, and the Traps Nobody Posts About](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/dubai-budget-guide.html): 4 days in Dubai for ₹45,000 — the metro-and-beach version. Flights, visa for Indians, free fountain shows, and the three tourist traps that quietly eat your budget.
- [Thailand Visa on Arrival for Indians: What Actually Happens at the Counter](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/thailand-visa-on-arrival.html): Documents, the 2,200 THB fee, the return-ticket check, and the three mistakes that get Indians pulled aside — plus the 15-day trap and when to get the 60-day visa instead.
- [Singapore in 4 Days for Under ₹60,000: The Itinerary That Skips Nothing Important](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/singapore-4-days.html): Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa à la carte, hawker-centre economics, and the VFTF visa loophole for Indians — the full 4-day Singapore build with real October 2026 costs.
- [Maldives Under ₹50,000 Exists — But Not the Way Travel Agents Sell It](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/maldives-budget-truth.html): Local-island guesthouses, ₹400 speedboats instead of seaplanes, bikini beaches on Maafushi and Dhigurah, and the free 30-day visa — the real Maldives budget guide.
- [Vietnam for First-Timers: 7 Days, ₹40,000, and the Pho Is Not the Point](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/vietnam-first-timers.html): Hanoi to Hoi An the right way — the 25 USD e-visa, the Hai Van Pass, tailor suits in 24 hours, and why the middle of the country is the actual destination.
- [Sri Lanka by Train Is the Best ₹30,000 Trip in the World. Here's the Route.](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/sri-lanka-train.html): The Kandy–Ella line, Nine Arch Bridge at sunrise, whale season in Mirissa, and the same-day ETA — the full 7-day Colombo–Kandy–Ella–south coast route with real costs.
- [Rajasthan in 10 Days: The Route That Skips the Tourist Conveyor Belt](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/rajasthan-10-days.html): Amber at 8 AM, the living fort of Jaisalmer, real dunes at Khuri, Ranakpur's marble, and the two endings — Pushkar or Ranthambore. The Rajasthan circuit worth the fuel.
- [Bhutan for Indians: The Only Place You Can't Overplan, and the 2026 Math](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/bhutan-for-indians.html): No visa for Indians — just the ₹1,200/night SDF. The Paro–Thimphu–Punakha route, Tiger's Nest timings, road vs flight, and why Bhutan costs what Himachal does.
- [Goa Beyond the Shacks: The Goa That Locals Keep for Themselves](https://brandingkant.github.io/posts/goa-beyond-beaches.html): Cola's blue lagoon, Fontainhas' Latin Quarter, Divar island by ferry, poi at 6 AM, and urrak season — the south-first Goa plan with real scooter-money math.
